rows.title: SaaS One-Pager Brand Refresh
rows.summary: Rebuild a flattened SaaS one-pager as an editable single-slide PowerPoint on Windows, apply the staged NorthstarOS rebrand changes, and export both a PPTX and a PNG.
rows.task_prompt:
You are editing a SaaS one-pager on a Windows VM.

## Variant
`base`: NorthstarOS one-pager brand refresh

## Runtime Entry Point
- Open PowerPoint from: `base\software\OpenPowerPoint.bat`

## Visible Inputs
- Source one-pager PNG: `base\input\original_onepager.png`
- Edit brief: `base\input\edit_request.txt`
- Brand guide PDF: `base\input\brand_guide.pdf`
- KPI data CSV: `base\input\metrics.csv`
- Chart data CSV: `base\input\chart_data.csv`
- Replacement assets directory: `base\input\assets`
- Task brief: `base\input\task_brief.md`
- Output contract: `base\input\output_contract.json`

## What You Must Do
1. Read the staged brief and input files.
2. Rebuild the one-pager as a meaningfully editable single-slide PowerPoint.
3. Apply the requested NorthstarOS brand refresh while preserving the overall composition.
4. Save the editable PowerPoint exactly to `base\output\edited_onepager.pptx`.
5. Export the final slide exactly to `base\output\edited_onepager.png`.

## Output Requirements
- The `.pptx` must remain meaningfully editable.
- Save only the final required deliverables inside `base\output`.
- Do not modify files under `input/`.
agent_must_do: Read the staged source one-pager, edit brief, brand guide, KPI CSV, chart CSV, and asset bundle from `input/`.
Rebuild the page as a meaningfully editable single-slide PowerPoint on Windows.
Apply the requested NorthstarOS brand refresh while preserving the overall composition.

input_files.name: original_onepager.png
input_files.description: Flattened source one-pager to recreate and refresh.

input_files.name: brand_guide.pdf
input_files.description: Visible palette and style direction for the refresh.

input_files.name: metrics.csv
input_files.description: Replacement KPI values for the three metric cards.

input_files.name: chart_data.csv
input_files.description: Replacement line-chart data for the throughput section.

input_files.name: assets
input_files.description: Visible logo, hero, headshot, QR, and icon assets, including original and replacement variants where supplied.

rows.title: Inkscape Cultural Poster Design
rows.summary: Create a single-page cultural exhibition poster in Inkscape on Windows using a staged design brief, a source photo, and a structured instance specification, then save the final poster as an SVG.
rows.task_prompt:
You are using Inkscape on Windows to design a cultural exhibition poster.

Read:
- `base\input\design_brief.txt`
- `base\input\instance_spec.txt` (GBK/GB18030 encoded Chinese)
- `base\input\installation_photo_01.jpg`

Create the poster in Inkscape and save the final SVG exactly to:
- `base\output\poster.svg`

Notes:
- Use Inkscape rather than generic image-generation tools.
- Preserve the source photo's aspect ratio when you place it.
agent_must_do: Read the staged design brief, instance specification, and installation photo from `input/`.
Use Inkscape on Windows to design a single-page cultural exhibition poster.
Preserve the source photo's aspect ratio when placing it into the poster.
Save the final SVG exactly as `output/poster.svg`.

input_files.name: design_brief.txt
input_files.description: Natural-language poster brief describing the exhibition theme and design direction.

input_files.name: instance_spec.txt
input_files.description: Structured instance specification defining canvas size, orientation, title, subtitle, and required phrase constraints.

input_files.name: installation_photo_01.jpg
input_files.description: Source installation photo that must be incorporated into the poster design.
